name: Caching & Cache Invalidation
description: Caching & Cache Invalidation standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-CACHE applies.

rules.title: Define cache ownership, key, TTL and invalidation before use
rules.detail: Every cache has an owner, key composition, value schema, TTL and explicit invalidation/refresh strategy.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define cache ownership, key, TTL and invalidation before use.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define cache ownership, key, TTL and invalidation before use.

rules.title: Never treat cache as the only durable source of truth
rules.detail: Loss or eviction of a cache must not destroy authoritative business data.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Never treat cache as the only durable source of truth.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Never treat cache as the only durable source of truth.

rules.title: Prevent cross-user or cross-tenant leakage
rules.detail: Cache keys and authorization checks must include all isolation dimensions needed to keep data scoped correctly.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prevent cross-user or cross-tenant leakage.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prevent cross-user or cross-tenant leakage.

rules.title: Handle stale data deliberately
rules.detail: Document acceptable staleness and choose cache-aside, write-through, refresh-ahead or explicit revalidation behavior accordingly.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Handle stale data deliberately.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Handle stale data deliberately.

rules.title: Bound cache size and stampede behavior
rules.detail: Apply size/eviction limits and use single-flight, jittered TTL or request coalescing for hot keys when needed.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Bound cache size and stampede behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Bound cache size and stampede behavior.

rules.title: Version cached payloads when schema can outlive deployments
rules.detail: Keys or payloads must remain compatible across rolling deployments or be safely invalidated.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Version cached payloads when schema can outlive deployments.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Version cached payloads when schema can outlive deployments.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-CACHE applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Caching & Cache Invalidation to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Caching & Cache Invalidation is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Caching & Cache Invalidation failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
